events.push: code is pushed to a branch
events.pull_request: a pull request is opened, updated, merged, or closed
events.release: a release is published, updated, or deleted
events.workflow_run: a GitHub Actions workflow is completed
events.repository: a repository is created, renamed, transferred, or deleted
events.issues: an issue is opened, edited, closed, reopened, assigned, labeled, or unlocked
events.issue_comment: an issue comment is created, edited, or deleted
events.pull_request_review: a pull request review is submitted, edited, or dismissed
events.pull_request_review_comment: a comment is created, edited, or deleted on a pull request
events.create: a branch or tag is created
events.delete: a branch or tag is deleted
events.star: a user stars or unstars the repository
events.watch: a user starts or stops watching the repository
events.check_run: a check run is created, rerequested, or completed
events.check_suite: a check suite is completed, requested, or rerequested
events.page_build: a Pages site is built or fails to build
events.repository_vulnerability_alert: a security vulnerability alert is created, dismissed, or resolved
events.security_advisory: a security advisory is published, updated, or withdrawn
events.sponsorship: a sponsorship is created, updated, or cancelled
events.team: a team is created, modified, or deleted
events.team_add: a team is added to a repository
events.member: a user is added, removed, or invited as a repository collaborator
events.membership: a user is added or removed from a team
events.label: a label is created, edited, or deleted
events.milestone: a milestone is created, updated, closed, or deleted
events.project: a project is created, updated, closed, or deleted
events.project_card: a project card is created, edited, or deleted
events.project_column: a project column is created, edited, or deleted
events.organization: an organization event occurs (user invited, renamed, deleted, etc.)
events.installation: a GitHub App is installed or uninstalled
events.installation_repositories: a repository is added or removed from an installation
events.status: the status of a commit changes
